lines.text: Dinner is ready, so dig in!

data.define: Used to invite people to begin eating.

example.text: Dinner is ready, so dig in!

misuse.text: Don't tell guests to 'dig in' before the host.
misuse.why: Formal dinners wait for the host.

data.l1_hook: डिनर तैयार है। कौन भूखा है? "dig in"
